name: Newfoundland and Labrador

standard.note: Newfoundland and Labrador's everyday plates start with A, H, J, C or M, and since 2023 the province has stopped using renewal stickers.

plates.title: Veteran Licence Plate
plates.supports: Run with the Provincial Command of the Royal Canadian Legion
plates.fact: There's no initial fee, and the Legion handles the applications.

plates.title: Fire Fighter Licence Plate
plates.supports: Run with Fire and Emergency Services
plates.fact: There's no initial fee for the plate.

notes: The Motor Registration 'Plates' page lists only Veterans and Fire Fighters (plus replacement pages), so the list is complete but has no pictures anywhere. A 'Confederation 75' logo plate went to vehicles first registered in 2024 and could be bought for current vehicles (gov.nl.ca/releases/2023/exec/1211n02/). It is still common on the road but the registry no longer lists it, so it was left out. Add it as cat 'other', year 2024, if wanted.
